description:
Find bought parts by free text: a name, part number, standard designation, size or what the part must do
    ('M3x12 socket head', '6811ZZ', 'feetech sts3215', 'waterproof 4 pin connector'). family narrows it (fastener,
    bearing, serial_bus_servo, bldc_actuator, compute, connector_cable, motion_transmission, structure, electronics);
    category narrows by a taxonomy path prefix ('fluid', 'fluid/fitting', 'sealing/o_ring', 'motion/bearing').
    Both keep parts not yet classified.
    Each result's `cad` says whether get_cad returns a STEP file; cad_only=true keeps only those. Standard screws, nuts,
    bearings and dowel pins in any listed size are generated on demand and come first.
name: search_parts
